purpose: Replacement for superseded UT Lab run R1: evaluate Gemini 3.5 Flash on the identical frozen random 15-task sample under a strict visible-task-UI-only interaction policy.

protocol.task_instruction: MANDATORY VISIBLE-UI-ONLY POLICY: Complete this task exclusively through the visible controls in the task's browser webpage or webpages. Do not open or use Developer Tools, Console, Debugger, Inspector, Network, Sources, View Source, DOM inspection, page-state inspection, or implementation/source inspection. Do not use a terminal, shell, code, scripts, Python, automation, the address bar, URL or query-parameter edits, browser extensions, other applications, or external tools. Do not reload, navigate, or close task pages. If the visible task UI itself provides controls that open additional task tabs, you may use only those tabs and their visible controls; never inspect their implementation. Solve only by observing screenshots and interacting with visible task UI controls. If blocked, keep reasoning from the visible UI; do not bypass these rules.
protocol.stop_policy: The model may finish early; otherwise stop after 100 model turns. Retry a candidate-less provider response after 2 and 5 seconds unless Google reports an explicit prompt block. A verifier failure is an experimental outcome; exhausted model-response retries are model API errors and are excluded from benchmark pass/fail counts.

provenance.dependency_mode: isolated benchmark-local virtual environment with editable links to this checkout and ../gym-anything
provenance.supersession_reason: Human requested an explicit ban on code, DevTools, console, terminal, and all non-task-tab interaction after R1 showed repeated strategy drift.
